findings.title: Current specialist return still overpromises production clearance

observed.required_before: scout/medic production (t_scout, t_medic) and family delivery (t_family); not the sample
observed.question: For the family: the final outline treatment and the final canvas (the controlled-evaluation answers bind the representative sample only); the role-differentiation device (and with it the palette confirmation, possibly a reserved accent); whether each output is a single sprite or an animation set; and the destination engine or importer.
observed.unlocks: Raster contracts for f_scout / f_medic whose linked choices are confirmed, clearance of the production-phase gates (task_decision, method_poc, choice_unconfirmed) together with evidence-backed D records for t_scout, t_medic and t_family, and q_engine_import on f_family. Answering adopts only the choices it names and accepts no artwork.
observed.worksheet_rows: R6 (later phases); decision-table rows i_outline, i_canvas, i_palette, i_role_diff, i_animation, i_engine

findings.assessment: The current Q3/unlocks explicitly promises clearance of task_decision, method_poc and choice_unconfirmed alongside contracts/D records. Its limited answer list does not establish the missing production contracts or all choices those contracts will actually link. No production contract exists for f_scout/f_medic; future adoption must be traced to the contract actually selected rather than inferred from c_sample. If sample aesthetic choices carry forward, unasked sampling, alpha, lighting and design-language choices remain proposed/observed. A D record does not establish current method proof for any later linked method. t_sample also remains open and required by both production tasks. The question may support named choices, but cannot promise this full clearance. General later-requirement lists and 'adopts only the choices it names' do not repair the explicit unlocks claim. The caller's new RQ3 softens the wording, yet its adoption keeps the defective specialist return/current c+b continuation in force.
